BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah sees two baskets of figs set before the temple, and the good figs are described as first-ripe, the earliest fruit of the season.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God notices what comes first, and the first-ripe fig is His picture of a people He still calls good.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
